runs.title: 14 Nov · small baseline pilot
runs.description: Two models trained on 22,916 moves from 106 games, for 20 epochs (458,320 move presentations). Compared rank input on versus off with the same small board network.
notes: One training seed. Only a few rank groups have development data; intervals are inconclusive.
Human SL is an external reference with different history/context and unknown training overlap.

runs.title: 18–19 Nov · expanded training
runs.description: Four models: rank on/off with 1 million 6.5-komi training moves, or 2 million moves including 0.5 komi. Each trained for 31,250 updates and 4 million move presentations.
notes: One new seed and larger training sets than the small pilot; the development sample also changed. Cross-run differences do not isolate one cause.
The original Human SL job hit its CPU cap. The saved completion review retains partial reference evidence, 20 of 24 game slots, missing ranks and inconclusive overall intervals.

runs.title: 19–20 Nov · wider evaluation rerun
runs.description: Reused the exact four expanded models without more training. Evaluated a wider frozen sample: 539 games and 120,450 positions, with complete 6.5-komi Human SL reports and all 24 game slots.
notes: Default comparison uses 12k–1d, chosen before prediction. Full 15k–1d diagnostics retain missing or weak support.
Every learned game had a premature-pass flag. Adding rank input worsened outcome error on unseen-account 0.5-komi positions. E2 readiness remains open.
The eight failed verifier rank-input checks were false positives. A separate saved-evidence assessment passed; the original failed attempt remains recorded.
